name: Vectisuchus
isnote: Described as a pholidosaurid mesoeucrocodylian (English Wikipedia); PBDB places it in Dyrosauroidea; placed in Neosuchia.
sum: Vectisuchus is a small piscivorous crocodylomorph with a narrow snout and long forearms from the Early Cretaceous Wealden Group of the Isle of Wight.
wsnote: The sources consulted do not give the body length.
holotype: Catalogue number not given in the sources consulted.
biology: Described as a piscivore with a narrow snout (English Wikipedia).
author: Buffetaut and Hutt 1980

sources.text: Buffetaut, E.; Hutt, S. 1980. ''Vectisuchus leptognathus'', n.g. n. sp., a slender-snouted goniopholid crocodilian from the Wealden of the Isle of Wight. Neues Jahrbuch für Geologie und Paläontologie, Monatshefte 1980(7): 385–390. doi:10.1127/njgpm/1980/1980/385
